calls.head: The Flames like Strömgren’s line against Couturier’s
calls.body: At home, the Flames keep sending Strömgren’s line (Strömgren, Castagna and Klapka) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Ryan Huska keeps choosing line for line. Tonight the Flyers’ fourth line is Barkey, Couturier and Acciari.

CGY.head: We had Calgary as slight underdogs (43%), and they pulled it off.

PHI.head: We leaned Philadelphia’s way (57%), but Calgary had other ideas.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Coronato ends it in overtime
paras: Denver Barkey got the scoring started for the Flyers midway through the first, but Zayne Parekh tied it up for Calgary less than three minutes later. Noel Acciari put the Flyers back ahead 2-1 early in the second. Zach Whitecloud tied it up for Calgary less than four minutes later, and Owen Tippett restored the Flyers’ lead on the power play late in the period. Joel Farabee tied it up for Calgary shorthanded midway through the third. Matt Coronato won it in overtime.

Nothing much separated these two on the chances. This one could have gone either way. Devin Cooley made 32 saves for the Flames, and Dan Vladař stopped 22 of 26 at the other end. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Sean Couturier, even in a loss and with Coronato’s overtime winner in the game, by our Swing measure. The Flames moved to 8-9-1, fifth in the Pacific, while the Flyers dropped to 4-10-5, still last in the Metropolitan.

items.text: Sean Couturier passed Rod Brind'Amour for ninth on the Flyers’ all-time assists list, with 367.
The Flyers are winless in three (0-2-1).
The Flames have beaten the Flyers five straight times, going back to the 2024-25 season.
Zach Whitecloud scored his first goal of the season, his first since Jan 11 (51 games played since).
